Tiara road!

took us by surprise with those unexpected 
turns, didn't it?"

text_block_list.text:
With Vodka out of the picture, is she 
entirely unchallenged now? Or will another 
front-runner leap into the spotlight—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...As planned, I ran in the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And just as planned, I will take first 
place in this race. Only then will 
everyone finally acknowledge me.
